name: Research paper from a harness run
description: Turn one completed ML Research Harness run into an English research paper. Select a dataset with the run files. The agent drafts an outline around the research question, explains the main findings and their limits, and checks reported measurements against the run evidence. Download the Markdown paper, its evidence-linked outline, and the validation record. See the README for V1, V2, and V3 input details. Uses an OpenRouter or OpenAI API connection. Model charges may apply.

run_folder.title: Run folder within selected datasets
run_folder.description: Enter the mounted dataset name, optionally followed by the subfolder containing the raw, complete harness run.
